name: tickets
description: Private support ticket threads with categories, claims, priorities, notes, tags, transcripts, and feedback

configFields.label: Transcript Channel
configFields.description: Channel that receives the HTML transcript when a ticket closes. Transcripts do not expire.

configFields.label: Additional Staff Roles
configFields.description: Roles treated as ticket staff in addition to category staff roles and permits

configFields.label: Auto-Close Inactive Tickets
configFields.description: Close open tickets whose last activity is older than the inactivity window

configFields.label: Inactivity Window (minutes)
configFields.description: Minutes of inactivity before an open ticket is closed automatically

configFields.label: Feedback Prompt
configFields.description: Ask the ticket opener for a 1-5 rating after the ticket closes

configFields.label: Max Open Tickets Per User
configFields.description: Maximum number of simultaneously open tickets one member may have

configFields.label: Ping Staff On Open
configFields.description: Ping the category ping roles when a ticket is opened
